title: Goldilocks and the Three Bears
moral: Say "I'm sorry," and you can be friends again.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 from 줄의 영어 녹음을 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

lines.text: 숲속 통나무집에 곰 세 식구가 살았어요.
lines.en: A family of three bears lived in a log cabin in the woods.
segs: A family of three bears lived in a log cabin in the woods.

lines.text: 아빠 곰은 커다랗고 뚱뚱, 엄마 곰은 날씬, 아기 곰은 조그맣고 귀여워요.
lines.en: Papa Bear is big and round, Mama Bear is slim, and Baby Bear is teeny tiny and oh so cute.
segs: Papa Bear is big and round, Mama Bear is slim, and Baby Bear is teeny tiny and oh so cute.

lines.text: 아빠 곰은 굵은 목소리, 아기 곰은 가느다란 목소리예요.
lines.en: Papa Bear has a deep voice, and Baby Bear has a tiny voice.
segs: Papa Bear has a deep voice, and Baby Bear has a tiny voice.

lines.text: 엄마 곰이 맛있는 죽을 끓였어요. 그런데 너무 뜨거워요!
lines.en: Mama Bear cooked some yummy porridge. But it's too hot!
segs: Mama Bear cooked some yummy porridge. But it's too hot!

lines.text: 후후, 후후! 곰 세 식구가 김이 모락모락 나는 죽을 불었어요.
lines.en: Whoo, whoo! The three bears blew on the steaming hot porridge, puff, puff.
segs: Whoo, whoo! The three bears blew on the steaming hot porridge, puff, puff.

lines.text: 김이 줄었지만, 아직 뜨거워요.
lines.en: The steam is going down, but it's still hot.
segs: The steam is going down, but it's still hot.

lines.text: 아빠 곰: "죽이 식을 동안 산책 다녀오자!"
lines.en: Papa Bear: "Let's go for a walk while the porridge cools!"
segs: Let's go for a walk while the porridge cools!

lines.text: 곰 가족은 뚜벅뚜벅, 사이좋게 숲으로 나갔어요.
lines.en: Off went the bear family into the woods, clomp, clomp, side by side.
segs: Off went the bear family into the woods, clomp, clomp, side by side.

lines.text: 숲속에는 금빛 머리 골디락스가 살았어요.
lines.en: In the woods lived a girl with golden hair, named Goldilocks.
segs: In the woods lived a girl with golden hair, named Goldilocks.

lines.text: 골디락스는 콧노래를 흥얼흥얼, 깡충깡충 숲길을 걸었어요.
lines.en: Goldilocks hummed a happy tune and skipped along the forest path, hop, skip, hop.
segs: Goldilocks hummed a happy tune and skipped along the forest path, hop, skip, hop.

lines.text: 꽃향기가 솔솔, 나비가 팔랑팔랑 날아다녔어요.
lines.en: The flowers smelled sweet, and butterflies fluttered all around, flutter, flutter.
segs: The flowers smelled sweet, and butterflies fluttered all around, flutter, flutter.

lines.text: 꽃을 세 송이 땄어요. 어? 저기 통나무집이 있어요!
lines.en: She picked three flowers. Oh? Look, a log cabin!

lines.text: 우와, 커다란 문이에요.
lines.from: 우와, 커다란 문이에요. 문을 톡 두드려 봐요.
lines.en: Wow, what a big door!

lines.text: 똑똑, 똑똑! 골디락스가 문을 두드렸어요.
lines.en: Knock, knock! Knock, knock! Goldilocks tapped on the door.
segs: Knock, knock! Knock, knock! Goldilocks tapped on the door.

lines.text: 골디락스: "계세요?"
lines.en: Goldilocks: "Hello? Is anyone home?"

lines.text: 아무 대답이 없어요.
lines.en: There is no answer.

lines.text: 문이 삐걱 열렸어요. 골디락스가 살짝 들어가 봤어요.
lines.en: The door creaked open. Goldilocks tiptoed inside.
segs: The door creaked open. Goldilocks tiptoed inside.

lines.text: 식탁 위에 죽이 세 그릇 있어요.
lines.en: There are three bowls of porridge on the table.
segs: There are three bowls of porridge on the table.

lines.text: 골디락스는 제일 큰 그릇을 한 입 호록!
lines.en: Goldilocks took a sip from the biggest bowl. Slurp!
segs: Goldilocks took a sip from the biggest bowl. Slurp!

lines.text: 펄펄 너무 뜨거워요!
lines.en: Hot, hot! It's way too hot!
segs: Hot, hot! It's way too hot!

lines.text: 이번엔 중간 그릇을 한 입 호록!
lines.en: Then a sip from the medium bowl. Slurp!
segs: Then a sip from the medium bowl. Slurp!

lines.text: 얼음처럼 너무 차가워요!
lines.en: It's way too cold, like ice!
segs: It's way too cold, like ice!

lines.text: 김이 살짝 나는 작은 그릇이에요!
lines.en: It's the small bowl with just a little steam!
segs: It's the small bowl with just a little steam!

lines.text: 딱 좋아요! 냠냠, 작은 그릇을 다 먹어 버렸어요.
lines.en: Just right! Yum, yum! She ate up the whole small bowl.
segs: She ate up the whole small bowl.

lines.text: 이번엔 의자가 세 개 있어요.
lines.en: Now there are three chairs.

lines.text: 영차! 골디락스는 제일 큰 의자에 기어올랐어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho! Goldilocks climbed up onto the biggest chair.
segs: Heave-ho! Goldilocks climbed up onto the biggest chair.

lines.text: 너무 높아요! 다리가 달랑달랑.
lines.en: It's too high! Her legs dangle, dangle.

lines.text: 중간 의자에는 털썩! 앉아 보았어요.
lines.en: Then she flopped down onto the medium chair. Plop!
segs: Then she flopped down onto the medium chair. Plop!

lines.text: 너무 푹신해서 쏙 파묻혔어요!
lines.en: It's so squishy, she sank right in!
segs: It's so squishy, she sank right in!

lines.text: 딱 맞아요! 그런데…
lines.en: Just right! But then...

lines.text: 뿌지직! 작은 의자가 부서져서 엉덩방아를 찧었어요.
lines.en: Crack! The little chair broke, and she plopped down on her bottom.
segs: Crack! The little chair broke, and she plopped down on her bottom.

lines.text: 하암, 졸려요. 위층에 침대가 세 개 있어요.
lines.en: Yaaawn, I'm sleepy. There are three beds upstairs.

lines.text: 큰 침대에 벌렁 누웠더니 등이 딱딱, 쿵!
lines.en: She flopped down on the big bed. It was hard as a rock. Thud!
segs: She flopped down on the big bed. It was hard as a rock. Thud!

lines.text: 너무 딱딱해요!
lines.en: It's too hard!

lines.text: 중간 침대는 푹신푹신, 몸이 쑥 파묻혔어요.
lines.en: The medium bed was squishy, squashy, and she sank right in.
segs: The medium bed was squishy, squashy, and she sank right in.

lines.text: 너무 푹신해요!
lines.en: It's too soft!

lines.text: 작은 침대는 포근포근, 딱 좋았어요.
lines.en: The small bed was snug and cozy, just right.
segs: The small bed was snug and cozy, just right.

lines.text: 골디락스는 쿨쿨 잠이 들었어요.
lines.en: Goldilocks fell fast asleep. Zzz.

lines.text: 그때 곰 가족이 산책에서 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: Just then, the bear family came home from their walk.
segs: Just then, the bear family came home from their walk.

lines.text: 아빠 곰: "누가 내 죽을 먹었지?"
lines.en: Papa Bear: "Who ate my porridge?"

lines.text: 엄마 곰도 그릇을 들여다보며 고개를 갸웃갸웃 기울였어요.
lines.en: Mama Bear peered into her bowl too and tilted her head, puzzled.
segs: Mama Bear peered into her bowl too and tilted her head, puzzled.

lines.text: 아기 곰: "내 죽을 다 먹어 버렸어!"
lines.en: Baby Bear: "Someone ate up all my porridge!"
segs: Someone ate up all my porridge!

lines.text: 의자도 뒤죽박죽! 아빠 곰이 으음, 눈살을 찌푸렸어요.
lines.en: The chairs were all topsy-turvy, too! Papa Bear frowned. Hmmm.
segs: The chairs were all topsy-turvy, too! Papa Bear frowned. Hmmm.

lines.text: 아기 곰: "으앙, 내 의자가 부서졌어!"
lines.en: Baby Bear: "Waaah, my chair is broken!"

lines.text: 엄마 곰이 아기 곰을 꼭 안아 주었어요.
lines.en: Mama Bear gave Baby Bear a big, tight hug.
segs: Mama Bear gave Baby Bear a big, tight hug.

lines.text: 그런데 위층에서 쿨쿨 소리가 나요.
lines.en: But then they heard a snoring sound upstairs.
segs: But then they heard a snoring sound upstairs.

lines.text: 아기 곰이 살금살금 가 보니, 누가 자고 있어요!
lines.en: Baby Bear tiptoed over, and someone was sleeping there!
segs: Baby Bear tiptoed over, and someone was sleeping there!

lines.text: 아기 곰이 이불을 살짝 들추자…
lines.en: Baby Bear gently lifted the blanket, and...
segs: Baby Bear gently lifted the blanket, and...

lines.text: 골디락스와 곰 세 마리 눈이 딱 마주쳤어요!
lines.en: Goldilocks and the three bears looked straight at each other!
segs: Goldilocks and the three bears looked straight at each other!

lines.text: 깜짝! 골디락스는 후다닥 창문으로 달려갔어요.
lines.en: Yikes! Goldilocks leapt up and dashed for the window, pitter-patter.
segs: Yikes! Goldilocks leapt up and dashed for the window, pitter-patter.

lines.text: 창문으로 나가려다 치마가 딱 걸렸어요!
lines.en: She tried to climb out the window, but her skirt got caught!
segs: She tried to climb out the window, but her skirt got caught!

lines.text: 골디락스가 돌아서서 말했어요. "미안해요."
lines.en: Goldilocks turned around and said, "I'm sorry."

lines.text: 골디락스: "허락 없이 들어와서 미안해요."
lines.en: Goldilocks: "I'm sorry I came in without asking."
segs: I'm sorry I came in without asking.

lines.text: 아빠 곰: "괜찮아. 다음엔 똑똑 하고 기다려 줘."
lines.en: Papa Bear: "It's okay. Next time, knock and wait for us."
segs: It's okay. Next time, knock and wait for us.

lines.text: 골디락스: "아기 곰 의자, 같이 고칠래?"
lines.en: Goldilocks: "Shall we fix Baby Bear's chair together?"
segs: Shall we fix Baby Bear's chair together?

lines.text: 뚝딱뚝딱, 쿵쿵! 골디락스와 곰 가족이 함께 의자를 고쳤어요.
lines.en: Bang, bang! Tap, tap! Goldilocks and the bears fixed the chair together.
segs: Bang, bang! Tap, tap! Goldilocks and the bears fixed the chair together.

lines.text: 짠! 의자가 다 고쳐졌어요.
lines.en: Ta-da! The chair is all fixed.
segs: Ta-da! The chair is all fixed.

lines.text: 아기 곰: "고마워! 우리 친구 하자!"
lines.en: Baby Bear: "Thank you! Let's be friends!"

lines.text: 엄마 곰이 새 죽을 끓였어요. 다 함께 먹어요!
lines.en: Mama Bear cooked fresh porridge. Let's all eat together!
segs: Mama Bear cooked fresh porridge. Let's all eat together!

lines.text: 작은 그릇, 중간 그릇, 큰 그릇! 차례대로 담았어요.
lines.en: Small bowl, medium bowl, big bowl! All filled in order.
segs: Small bowl, medium bowl, big bowl! All filled in order.

lines.text: 골디락스 그릇도 하나 더! 다 함께 냠냠.
lines.en: One more bowl for Goldilocks! Yum, yum, all together.
segs: One more bowl for Goldilocks! Yum, yum, all together.

lines.text: 호록호록, 냠냠! 네 식구가 둘러앉아 맛있게 먹었어요.
lines.en: Slurp, slurp, yum, yum! The four of them sat around the table and ate happily.
segs: Slurp, slurp, yum, yum! The four of them sat around the table and ate happily.

lines.text: 골디락스와 곰 가족은 사이좋은 친구가 되었답니다.
lines.en: Goldilocks and the bear family became good friends.
segs: Goldilocks and the bear family became good friends.

lines.text: "미안해요" 하면 다시 친구가 될 수 있답니다.
lines.en: Say "I'm sorry," and you can be friends again.
segs: Say "I'm sorry," and you can be friends again.
